code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

rows=[
 ('Na1','Q68','Q146','conserved','sidechain OE1 (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('Na1','S99','C177','bb-preserved','only backbone C=O coordinates; mainchain retained'),
 ('Na1','Q261','Q339','conserved','sidechain OE1 (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('Na2','S105','S183','conserved','sidechain OG (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('Na2','S119','S197','conserved','sidechain OG (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('Na2','T123','T201','conserved','sidechain OG1 (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('Na2','E257','E335','conserved','sidechain OE2 (direct Na+ ligand)'),
 ('BA pocket','N103','N181','conserved','polar anchor (H-bond)'),
 ('BA pocket','L104','L182','conserved','pocket lining'),
 ('BA pocket','N262','N340','conserved','polar anchor (H-bond)'),
 ('BA pocket','V263','V341','conserved','pocket lining'),
 ('BA pocket','Q264','Q342','conserved','polar anchor (H-bond)'),
 ('BA pocket','L287','L365','conserved','pocket lining'),
 ('BA pocket','L35','L113','conserved','pocket lining'),
 ('BA pocket','L31','V109','substituted','conservative hydrophobic'),
 ('BA pocket','V32','G110','substituted','loss of sidechain'),
 ('BA pocket','M34','A112','substituted','conservative hydrophobic'),
 ('BA pocket','I38','T116','substituted','hydrophobic->polar'),
 ('BA pocket','V202','L280','substituted','conservative hydrophobic'),
 ('BA pocket','T203','F281','substituted','small->bulky aromatic'),
 ('BA pocket','S267','T345','substituted','conservative polar'),
 ('BA pocket','M290','A368','substituted','conservative hydrophobic'),
 ('BA pocket','I291','L369','substituted','conservative hydrophobic'),
 ('BA pocket','L294','S372','substituted','hydrophobic->polar'),
]
colmap={'conserved':'#2ca02c','bb-preserved':'#98df8a','substituted':'#d62728'}
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,9)); ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('SLC10A4 (Q96EP9) retains NTCP/SLC10A1 Na+ sites and bile-acid pocket core\n'
             'Residue mapping from NW alignment (37.5% id) onto human NTCP cryo-EM 7ZYI (Goutam 2022, PMID 35545671)',
             fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
hdr=['Site','NTCP','SLC10A4','Status','Role']
y0=0.95; dy=0.037
for k,h in enumerate(hdr):
    ax.text([0.02,0.18,0.30,0.44,0.60][k], y0, h, fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
for r,(site, n,a,st,role) in enumerate(rows):
    y=y0-(r+1)*dy
    ax.text(0.02,y,site,fontsize=9)
    ax.text(0.18,y,n,fontsize=9)
    ax.text(0.30,y,a,fontsize=9)
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((0.43,y-0.008),0.012,0.02,color=colmap[st]))
    ax.text(0.455,y,st,fontsize=9,color=colmap[st])
    ax.text(0.60,y,role,fontsize=8)
# summary box
ax.text(0.02,0.02,'Na1: 2/2 sidechain ligands conserved (+backbone intact).  Na2: 4/4 ligands conserved.\n'
        'Bile-acid pocket: all 3 polar anchors (N103,N262,Q264) + Q261 conserved; substitutions are mostly conservative hydrophobic lining changes.',
        fontsize=9, style='italic', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round',fc='#fff3cd',ec='#ffc107'))
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('slc10a4_ntcp_residue_conservation.png',dpi=140,bbox_inches='tight')
print('saved figure')
# counts
from collections import Counter
na=[r for r in rows if r[0].startswith('Na')]; ba=[r for r in rows if r[0]=='BA pocket']
print('Na sites conserved/bb:',sum(1 for r in na if r[3] in('conserved','bb-preserved')),'/',len(na))
print('BA pocket conserved:',sum(1 for r in ba if r[3]=='conserved'),'/',len(ba))
